steps.title: Cook the Bulgur
steps.text: Pour the water for the bulgur into a saucepan with the chicken stock paste and bring to the boil. Stir in the bulgur, bring back to the boil, then simmer for 1 min. Pop a lid on the pan and remove from the heat. Leave to the side for 12-15 mins or until ready to serve.

steps.title: Fry the Beef
steps.text: Heat a drizzle of oil in a frying pan on medium-high heat. Once hot, add the beef mince and fry until browned, 5-6 mins. Break it up as it cooks, then drain excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Get Prepped
steps.text: While the beef cooks, chop the tomatoes into 1cm pieces. Pick the mint leaves from their stalks and roughly chop (discard the stalks). Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).

steps.title: Simmer the Sauce
steps.text: Add the garlic, chermoula spice mix and tomato puree to the beef. Cook for 1 min. Stir in the pomegranate molasses, remaining stock paste if using, sugar and water for the sauce. Simmer until reduced and sticky.

steps.title: Mix the Mint Yoghurt
steps.text: In a small bowl, combine the yoghurt with half the mint. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Finish and Serve
steps.text: Fluff up the bulgur with a fork and stir through the tomatoes and remaining mint. Share the tabbouleh between bowls, top with the chermoula beef, a dollop of mint yoghurt, and a handful of rocket drizzled with olive oil. Enjoy!

steps.title: Cook the Rice
steps.text: Boil a kettle. Halve, peel and chop the onion. Peel and grate the garlic. Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10-12 mins, then drain, return to the pan and cover.

steps.title: Toasting Time
steps.text: Heat a large frying pan on medium heat (no oil). Toast the flaked almonds until golden, 2-3 mins, then tip into a bowl.

steps.title: Cook the Mince
steps.text: Return the pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Fry the beef mince until browned, 4-5 mins. Drain excess fat and season. Roughly chop the coriander.

steps.title: Add the Flavour
steps.text: Add the onion and garlic to the mince and cook until softened. Stir in the harissa paste, turmeric, beef stock paste and water for the beef. Simmer, then add the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Mix the Coriander Yoghurt
steps.text: Combine the yoghurt with half the coriander. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Share the beef pilaf between bowls. Top with coriander yoghurt, remaining coriander, and toasted almonds. Enjoy!

title: Beef and Pea Keema Curry with Garlicky Naans

steps.title: Fry Time
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Chop the red onion. Fry the beef mince until browned. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Get Prepped
steps.text: Add the chopped onion to the mince and cook 4-5 mins. Chop the coriander and grate the garlic.

steps.title: Simmer and Spice
steps.text: Lower the heat, add the spice mix and half the garlic. Add passata, stock paste and water. Simmer 5-6 mins until thickened.

steps.title: Toast the Cashews
steps.text: Dry-fry the cashew nuts 1-2 mins until toasted.

steps.title: Finish Up
steps.text: Mix remaining garlic with oil, brush onto naans, and bake 3-4 mins. Add peas and half the coriander to the curry and simmer 1-2 mins.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide the beef and pea keema curry into bowls. Top with toasted cashews and remaining coriander. Serve with halved garlic naans. Enjoy!

steps.title: Make the Pickled Shallot
steps.text: Preheat oven to 220°C. Thinly slice the shallot. Mix cider vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper in a small bowl; add half the shallot and set aside.

steps.title: Get Prepped
steps.text: Slice the green pepper into thin strips. Peel and grate the garlic.

steps.title: Brown the Mince
steps.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan. Fry the beef mince and green pepper 5-6 mins. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sambal Mayo Time
steps.text: Mix half the sambal with mayonnaise in a small bowl.

steps.title: Bring on the Spicy Sauce
steps.text: Add garlic to the pan with the beef for 1 min. Stir in bulgogi sauce and remaining sambal. Simmer 1 min. Warm tortillas in the oven 1-2 mins.

steps.title: Assemble your Tacos
steps.text: Spread sambal mayo on warmed tortillas. Top with the beef filling and pickled shallots. Enjoy!
